From the creator of Super Koopa RPG and Legend of the Axem Rangers comes Mario’s Endless Nightmare: a SMRPG Roguelike hack! Fight your way through waves and waves of foes as you try to awaken Mario from the slumbering curse placed upon him! There are two main game modes:

The main campaign. You’ll fight through various groups of enemies and bosses that mirror the progression of the original game. In between batches of foes, you’ll have to opportunity to save, heal, and shop. You can replay any battle rooms you’ve previously cleared, so grinding for additional resources is an option. You could even choose not to recruit any additional allies if you wanted.
The Pit of 100 Nightmares. Fight your way through 100 floors of battles while experiencing roguelike elements, such as randomly added allies, paying for random items and equipment, and random groups of enemies (that still follow a progression that makes sense).

Notable features include:

* An optional Pit of 100 Trials (different from the Pit of 100 Nightmares).
* The ability to switch ALL allies, including Mario.
* The ability to choose the song that plays in battle.
* New items that permanently boost ally stats.
* New equipment with various abilities.
* New enemies, including rare enemies that drop Frog Coins.

467032.overview: This ROM Hack collects user submitted levels for judging by members of the RetroAchievements 's community.

468789.overview: After the Tantabus, the dream monster that threatened to turn Equestria into a living nightmare, was defeated, Princess Luna thought she could finally sleep peacefully, but it turns out that the Tantabus wasn't actually defeated. Parts of it escaped into the real world, and the parts have been giving ponies all over Equestria nightmares. Can Celestia and Luna venture across Equestria, destroy the Tantabus particles, and save everypony before it's too late?

468866.overview: An opposite hack of Super Metroid in which you must place items throughout the world instead of obtaining them.

468867.overview:
One day Lumi the Goblin woke up and realized she was STARVING, so she decided to walk down to the local supermarket to see if they had any gyros. This is her story.

This is a semi-difficult Kaizo light hack. If you had to ask I'd say maybe a 6.5/10 or so? Or a 7? If Quickie is a 1 and Casio is a 10. I dunno, its hard to define difficulty for kaizo hacks, its all in the eye of the beholder. Well I am bad at Kaizo Mario, and this is about a 6.5. So hopefully that'll inform your download choice.

The levels in this hack are usually built around a gimmick or concept. The hack itself is rather chocolatey, though the gimmicks are USUALLY less in ASM and more in sprites and interesting level design. My goal in this hack (and most hacks) is to get people to go "WHAT THE HECK" as soon as they see a level (though usually use a word different than heck), then find out they really like the level anyway

Things this hack has:

Goblins
Trashcans
96 fugumannen (Yes, 96 different fugu. Its my favorite sprite.)
Chocolatey design
Gyros (hopefully!)
Cutscenes where Lumi dyed her hair for 5 minutes cause I couldn't fix that issue lol I dunno
Some humor, depending on how much of a fuddy duddy you are.
No trolls or deadly kaizo blocks. Mischief is fun, trolls are not.
A secret room in every single level, the "Murr Room" of that level

468998.overview:
Baron of Shell is a hack that I've had in the works for almost two years. It is my take on a classic shell hack, but it includes more traditional platforming elements than today's shell hacks. It uses traditional shell physics. There is a practice / tutorial path that provides insight into some of the more esoteric item abuse setups.

My goal with this hack was to show how diverse shell levels can be, and to push the narrative on item abuse in Super Mario World. Although there are a lot of Uberasm patches and custom sprites at work, the hack at its core is vanilla and vanilla inspired.

--- Disclaimer (1) ---

This hack is not made for everyone. There are a lot of people who will hate this hack; it was not made for them. It was made for the players who love shells and item abuse.

--- Disclaimer (2) ---

This hack has can cause repetitive strain injury if you are not careful. Please take periodic breaks so you don't hurt yourself.

--- Disclaimer (3)

This hack uses Uberasm that requires BOTH L & R to be used. If you use a nontraditional joystick or remap your buttons, this may be a problem for you.

469016.overview:
"A Rushed Project" is a mini SMW hack with 7 exits in total, but with a small twist, each of those levels contains a different gimmick, graphics and others made within one hour.

This hack features:
- All 7 levels features a new gimmick and theme
- The level design of each level was done under 1 hour (except for the last one)
- This hack had 4 full days of development in total
- Sonic the Hedgehog as the main character, for some reason

469018.overview: A kaizo Super Mario World hack.

470007.overview: A fan-made port of Super C from the NES to SNES, by the ROM hacker infidelity. Includes a full MSU-1 soundtrack.

470270.overview:
'Mario never returned from his last venture and rumours of a quiz crazy lunatic echo throughout the land. It's up to his dear brother Luigi and his trusty friend Captain Toad to adventure out and find some answers.'

I finally bring you - Gambol 2. Another year in the making, and a direct sequel to my first hack.

Unlike the precursor, this hack features some light sprinkles of chocolate mechanics, so be prepared for some custom gimmicks and sprites but still within the realms of that classic vanilla 'feel'. This time we've got 18 exits to chew through. Face 3 worlds in any order and find the 3 switch palaces before taking on the final test.

Difficulty sits around mid intermediate - but I hope you've been polishing those kaizo skills as this will be a step up in difficulty from the first hack. The focus when creating this was still fun platforming and movement, so hopefully a chill time for experienced players but a friendly challenge for those in the intermediate range.

Oh, and there might be a little cape section, you have been warned.

Features:
- 18 exits, including 3 switch palaces.
- Entirely using sampled ports, including two ports made specifically for this hack by the amazing Ahrion and Com_Poser.
- Automatically saves midways and exit count.
- Vanilla mash up and custom GFX edits made by myself.
- Text file included of all ports used.

470273.overview:
Claustrophobia is a series of  1-screen kaizo levels.

Notice this is not a real "puzzle" hack, but due to the nature of 1-screen levels it may present puzzle features.
The intention here is more to test the players skills than his ability to solve problems, even though theres a lot of figuring out to do.

470275.overview: A crude collaborative kazio Mario hack.

470291.overview: You play as a Goomba and you can't jump.

470387.overview:
Dragon’s Lair has been ported to the Super Nintendo Entertainment System.

Super Dragon’s Lair Arcade is a full-motion video (FMV) title for real NTSC SNES hardware using MSU-1 audio and video. It runs on SD2SNES / FXPAK Pro.

This project recreates the 1983 arcade laserdisc release on the SNES, preserving the original animation and gameplay timing while adapting it to the 16-bit hardware.

470505.overview:
(This is supposed to take place after SMB Wonder) Mario takes the wrong pipe to the mushroom kingdom and gets lost. While Mario is in Piranha Island, Bowser kidnaps the princess. It’s up to Mario to save Princess Peach!

developer note: ASMW is completed. It is currently going through bug fixes as of September 28th 2026

470556.overview:
I hope you like Crateria, because this hack is all about Crateria! Expect custom enemies, bosses, items and more!
Depths of Crateria aims to sit in-between veteran and vanilla for difficulty. The only special vanilla skill you need is shinesparking.

470593.overview: A nude mod for Super Metroid.

471101.overview:
This hack has many full jump setups, or "pressing and holding buttons".
This hack has many shells, but it is NOT a shelljumps hack.

471102.overview:
This is the continuation of the Easyland project, a hackrom completely dedicated to beginner kaizos players.
But don't be fooled, with intuitive tricks, it has gradual difficulty depending on its worlds. It's actually easier once you understand the setups.
It has short levels but with good intensity.
Attention: It has a lot of shells but it is not a shelljumps hack.

471142.overview: This hack recreates the gameplay of I Wanna Be The Guy.  It doesn't really focus on traps, but rather pure platforming and precision.

471380.overview:
"I had a bad dream"
"Don't be afraid, bad dreams are only dreams. What a time you chose to be born in..."


Fulfill The Dream is the second installment in the Chamber Anthology and the follow up to my first hack The 4th Chamber.


The saga continues as we follow Luigi's fatalistic tale coming up under the dark shroud of Bowser's Empire.


If you played The 4th Chamber, expect similar design but a more linear gaming experience.
My goal was to make a more accessible hack with better balance that experienced players would still have fun with and find a challenge in. My intent
was to keep the focus on running, jumping and platforming with a few chocolate twists thrown in.

471386.overview:
So the inspiration for this is that there are LOTS of shell hacks.
BUT, there aren't any resources on how to learn to shell jump.
(Other than banging your head against shell hacks that don't teach the mechanics of what's going on.)

Going forward,
It's assumed that you know the basic mechanics of Vanilla Super Mario World.
This isn't meant to be an exhaustive guide to every Kaizo or Shell technique in SMW.
It won't be covering basic techniques like Re-grabs, Fast Falling, Slow Falling, Etc.
Which are all covered in Learn 2 Kaizo, Kaizo Kindergarten, and 2Kaizo2Learn, to name a few.
(Honestly, if you haven't played those yet, you really should.)

What it will be covering are Shell Jumps, Shell Techniques and Shell Glitches. Some of which can be pretty difficult!
So, as one of my favorite you-tubers would say; "Sit down, grab a nice warm cup of Yorkshire Tea Gold and get comfortable!"

471398.overview:
Welcome to the Polyphonic Isles, a land once peaceful, now occupied by remnants of Bowser's formidable army as he clears through the land.

Venture deep into the Polyphonic Isles and clear the twin thrones in this hybrid standard/kaizo light hack, designed to give newcomers to kaizo a place to begin (in the primary route) while also providing greater challenges and mysteries to uncover for the more seasoned veteran looking to explore!

Deliberate effort was put into making this hack fun, varied and engaging for speedrunners, with 5 different run categories on SRC and an abundance of intentional (and some unintentional) speed and safe strategies to provide depth.

Featuring:
-Fast Retry
-A fully custom soundtrack, including a handful of original ports!
-A primary, mostly-standard path and an divergent, true kaizo path as you venture to the North.
-25 hidden portrait rooms (see if you can find them all!)
-22 Moons - One in every level! Some are a challenge to gather, while others hint at deeper secrets...

471520.overview:
Of Jumps and Platforms (or OJaP, in short) is a SMW hack of hard-very hard difficulty, heavily focused on platforming. It contains a total of 7 exits, carefuly crafted and balanced to offer a difficulty progression through them. Inspired by hacks like slurdgery, Nachos and Fried Oreos and mice, Of Jumps and Platforms offers some hard, challenging platforming action through each one of the levels, each one containing an asm-focused gimmick.
Story: Bowser has prepared a special obstacle course for Mario that ends up in his castle. Will he be able to survive it?

471528.overview:
This ROM hack gives a fresh new flavor to the Secret of Mana. The various regions of the world now have different climates and the 8 palaces swapped their elements. Palettes, monsters and NPCs dialogues have been changed to create coherent environments while remaining true to the original game.

Small sections of the game maps have been modified in various ways to keep you entertained, confused, lost, annoyed, or simply to aesthetically align with the new landscape.

Features :

- Additional maps and dungeons, edited maps.
- Acquiring magic elementals in a different order and custom spells.
- Swapped/new versions of enemies and bosses.
- New and modified story events.
- Shops armors changed from Mandala and beyond (making the Tasnica shop relevant).

471674.overview:
This is Reverie. It's a cryptic puzzle hack about a dream. It would be wise to take notes.

Originally made for Questionable Hackjam. This version, however, contains significantly more to do. If you've already played the contest version and want to check out the addition

471678.overview:
This is a hack inspired by the original game "Songs for a Hero", created by Castro Brothers and developed by Dumativa.

The game starts easy, but as it progresses, it starts to get difficult. There are enemy trolls, watch out!

471684.overview:
A Kaizo light hack for beginners!

The tricks and set ups start very easy but tend to get a bit more difficult further on.

Features:

- No hidden coin blocks
- 3 switch palaces with 3 different secret exits to find
- A very easy "puzzle" required to beat the game
- No water levels!
- Cool disco dance room
- Levels are linear and clear of what is required

471699.overview:
Step into the collaborative world of Shellab with 10 levels ranging in difficulty from Advanced to Expert.
Each level designed by a different creator with gameplay intended to be a balance of challenging & fun!
Every level contains 1 exit & a shoutout room dedicated to the creator of the level.
Shoutout rooms are all accessible via pipes in plain view & will temporarily disable controller inputs (except down) until returning back to the level.
The overworld is unlocked to encourage player progression, however level dots will turn from red to green after completion to track progress.
Beware this hack contains plenty of shell jumps and some light trolling here & there!
In this hack you will not find any back drops, front drops, or midairs.

471707.overview:
Super Machok World is a speedrun focused hard platforming/light kaizo hack. 11 somewhat short levels with somewhat tight timers and medium to hard platforming. Some light kaizo/item abuse is sprinkled in with some shell jumps. My goal was to have platforming with flow. This hack is more like a basic smb 1 speedrun in spirit and gameplay, with some smw spice on top :) The name comes from the mexican smw player and streamer RBMachok.

Its an open world map where you have to beat the first 9 levels in any order, to get to the last 2. I did this so new players can check out more levels than just the first if they get stuck. Veteran players can also use this as a strategy when setting WR, by doing the levels in their
prefered order.

There is custom music and a little bit of custom gfx. Retry patch and endless lives are active. There are levels where you can save your progress if you play on hardware.

471708.overview:
Are you having trouble breaking into Kaizo? Robfather world centers around intermediate platforming with small sprinkles of kaizo, allowing you to work on your dexterity and practice for the big titles.

Play as Robfather, who vows to destroy his sworn enemy - the munchers - before they destroy him first.

Enjoy a 100% original soundtrack to go along with this beginner light-kaizo.

471712.overview: This is a PG-13 rated vanilla ROM hack of Super Mario World. Created around 2004 by a member of the LUE message board from GameFAQs. There are some inside memes/jokes in the game, but also some universal internet memes of that 2004 era.

471765.overview:
Keys, keys everywhere.
In this hack you need to know how to use a key.
You will need frame perfect keyjumps, clips and lots of knowledge about this game to be able to beat it.

471768.overview:
This level is too hard...

It has 6 ASMs happening at once...

471769.overview: There are 4 switches and a special world, so be on the lookout for secrets!

471812.overview: Princess Peach is gone again... Is this Bowser's doing once more? Well then, let's set out.

471889.overview:
Features

» 8-bit styled graphics, music and sound effects.
» Takes advantage of SNES' Mode 0, using 4 layers at 2bpp, thus allowing for more alive environments.
» Some callbacks to the Mario franchise's story, and possibly in the future to the whole Nintendo story.
» Luigi-like physics for player 2. It is recommended to play as Mario, though, since Luigi doesn't use different GFX.
» Aims to be a throwback to earlier Mario games with every aspect, even level design (use of CCST-type of level designing).
» Three different powerups: Fire Flower, Ice Flower and Raccoon Leaf.
» Two HUDs to use: classic and modern. You can switch between them in the overworld with L/R. Switching to the classic HUD will play a coin SFX while switching to the modern one will play the "item coming out of block" SFX.
-The classic one looks like Super Mario Bros.'s original HUD.
-The modern one has a beam-like design and is on the upper left edge of the screen.
» Friendly pause menu that allows for easily exiting completed levels and displays lives and Star Coins to compensate for the classic HUD not showing them.
» Soundtrack with classic tunes, remix of them and original compositions.
» One world to play, with only the final level being unfinished.
» Free overworld where the player can move anywhere on it.
» An unique gimmick for each level.

471891.overview:
The floodgate has been opened!

"The future, where polar ice caps have melted, covering our land with water. Those who survived have adapted to a new world."

Waterworld's philosophy is "what if water levels were good?"
The levels of this game were designed around interesting setups combined with water. Forget those moments where you were swimming around in a muncher maze.
During your dive course you will experience mostly vanilla levels but you will find choco sprinkles on the shores.

471949.overview:
-There are no Kaizo Blocks! Except for the last Level, because it is a part of a mechanic.
-Short Levels without CP
-Fast Inputs
-Shell Knowledge required!
-A little taste of Chocolate.

471954.overview: This hack began as an entry for the 12 Days Before Christmas hacking contest.. As such, there are only 12 levels, and they aren't very long.

471956.overview: Here is a hack which changes all the track layouts, some of the graphics, title screen, and also the drivers.

471968.overview: The premise of this hack is that every level is on a tight timer, so there's no time to relax!

472162.overview:
Tired of simultaneous strike that plagues momentum in the older Nintendo Wars entries plaguing the momentum of Super Famicom Wars? This patch will fix that, by having the attacker actually attack first like they do in the Advance Wars games. This will improve expression with directs and especially prevent counterattack damage in matchups where that shouldn’t be a concern.

As an added bonus, an additional patch is available to eliminate luck damage by the defender to further preserve momentum.

472390.overview: Inspired by Super Mario All-stars, Super Mario Bros. 1, Super Mario Bros. 3, Super Mario Land, Super Mario World and Mario Forever but it's a SMAS: SMB1 Style.

472661.overview: Modernized version of Super Mario World - Bowser’s Return with new graphics, bosses, enemies and improved levels.

473387.overview:
Super Punch-Out!! (1994, SNES) is one of the best arcade-style boxing games ever made. You play as an up-and-coming boxer fighting your way through four circuits of increasingly absurd opponents, each with their own patterns, tells, and personality. The gameplay is fast, stylish, and deeply satisfying to master — a perfect arcade-like experience that holds up completely.

Super Punch-Out!! contains a hidden 2-player mode that was never exposed through the normal menu. In this mode, holding a specific button combination causes Controller 2 to control the opponent — effectively turning a single-player game into a local versus match. This secret was first publicly discovered in 2022.

This hack makes that experience a first-class feature. Instead of having to input secret button combinations, you select VERSUS MODE from the game’s Mode Select menu just like any other mode. No combination, no guesswork.

As it stands, this is the definitive version of the game. The Versus mode is inherently unbalanced — but it’s the version most players wished Nintendo had shipped back in the ’90s. They eventually added a proper VS mode in the Wii sequel many years later. The “Special Edition” name is a nod to the game’s ultimate hidden circuit!

473625.overview:
Super Mario World: The Definitive Edition is a ROM-Hack of the original Super Mario World game on the Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES). It was made originally as a remaster of the Super Mario World Plus hack which was released in May of 2024. Definitive Edition started progress in early 2025 around February.

The hack is meant to add bugfixes from the original game, add all new content (from things such as SMAS+SMW, Super Mario Advance 2, the Super Mario Maker series, the VLDC ROM-Hacks by SMWCentral, and prototypes themself of SMW) such as course themes, music, sprites, level structures, features, and others. There are also a couple extra new things that were added which were never originally in any adaption of SMW. More info can be found in the changelog.txt

The hack is inspired by many things such as SMAS+SMW, SMA2, SMM series, VLDC hacks, SMW protos, SMW Remastered, SMW 30th Anniversary Edition, SMW Just Keef Edition, SMW Redone, IsoFrieze/Dotsarecool romhacks, the New Super Mario Bros. series + SMB Wonder, and MaternalBound 2 Redux.

474248.overview:
Suspicious Space Pirate activity has been detected by the Galactic Federation in the remote Tog’Tassano system and Samus is sent to check it out. Discover the truth of what’s going on and power yourself up in this frigid, hostile environment.

Cryogenesis 1.0 was originally created for a streaming contest and has since been expanded on to create a longer hack experience. 2.0 is a sprawling, full adventure that builds on that foundation.

Features many mechanics changes:

* New and reimagined powerups
* Boss modifications
* Custom room events
* The hack has a focus on atmospheric storytelling and detailed visuals, building an entirely new environment for Samus to experience, explore, and ultimately explode.

Although challenging moments will still arise, the hack is designed for even a player with zero Super Metroid skills. The only techniques required for completion will be taught to you in game.

474249.overview:
An all-in-one bugfix patch that keeps the authentic feeling of Super Metroid intact.

“Super Metroid: Fix Collection Patch” is a purist-friendly bugfix patch that addresses various flaws and inconveniences in Super Metroid.

Over the years, numerous fixes were developed and included in larger projects, such as “Super Metroid Redux” and “Project Base”. These projects are masterpieces when it comes to ROM hacks, but they also make substantial changes to the game that may not appeal to some players.

The aim of this patch is to isolate some of these fixes and provide them in a single collection, creating the cleanest possible vanilla Super Metroid experience while preserving the original game design, controls, mechanics, balance, and intended feel.

474259.overview:
This is the last Easyland romhack, completing the trilogy!

A kaizo dedicated to beginner players, now with a slightly higher difficulty level in this third version.

If you've never played kaizo, starting with Easyland 1 might be a great option.

Easyland 3 now has slightly more complex setups, bringing a greater challenge, but the levels are still short.

The trolls at the end of each level bring a lot of smiles, both for those playing and those watching, so get ready to encounter many trolls.

Important: this hack explores tricks where the "neutral directional pad" can facilitate victory.
This kaizo dont have Puzzles.

474264.overview:
On a quest to recover all of the Mushroom Kingdom’s stolen beer, Toadette and Lodette embark on a daunting adventure but get separated on an evening of reprieve. Now journeying alone, both must navigate through twists and turns to try and find each other again and save the day. There are 36 exits for 100% completion with optional “mini-games” if you want to go the extra mile.

You can change adventures anytime in 1 player mode by pressing “R” on the Overworld. 2 player mode works the same as Vanilla. This hack has multiple endings for those looking for a short playthrough or a lengthy adventure, the choice is yours.

474312.overview:
This is a hack that changes various gameplay mechanics for Arthur including:

* Power decrementation on hit (return to previous armor)
* Weapon collecting and switching between them with the L/R buttons
* Shields that will not break by blocking with them
* A slightly slower timer

These changes will make the game much easier, so it is recommended to change the difficulty to the professional setting.

475055.overview:
Experience the classic SMW2+2 with a fresh new twist!

* Levels have been given a face lift, new palettes, backgrounds, etc.
* Be prepared for tougher challenges! Additional enemies are now present, more obstacles await, and bonus items have been rearranged for a trickier 100% challenge
* Some levels have completely new areas!
* Brand new levels have been added! Either the Extra or the Secret level of each world has been replaced with a completely new level

475114.overview:
After the Koopa Bros. saved the world during the events of Super Koopa RPG, Bowser decides to host a party at his Keep to celebrate. He invites Mario, Luigi, Toadstool, and Kooper. …But there may be more to this party than meets the eye. As part of his master plan, Bowser orders the Koopa Bros. to defeat Mario. Who will emerge victorious?

This romhack was created for the Big Yoshi Romhacking Discord’s August 2025 romhacking contest. The theme of the contest is to make a hack that centers around a boss fight. It was made in a little less than 2 months.

480251.overview:
This is a romhack/hack/mod of Super Mario RPG (SNES) that adds various content that was previously exclusive to the Super Mario RPG remake released on the Nintendo Switch.



*****************
Features include:
*****************

* Additional story events related to the postgame content.
* Rematches of previous bosses with similar mechanics to the remake
(Bundt, Belome, Punchinello, Jinx, Booster, Johnny, and Culex).
* New ultimate weapons for Geno, Mallow, and Bowser (the Stella 023,
Sage Stick, and Wonder Chomp, respectively).
* New accessories and items.
* Red, quick moving barrels have been added to Booster Hill.
* Fast travel options have been added to quickly warp to the start and
end of certain levels after progressing to certain points within them:
Booster Tower, Sunken Ship, Factory, Bowser's Keep
* New story scenes in the main game previously exclusive to the remake
* You can now hold B to auto scroll through text.

481334.overview:
Shin Shogi Club ("New Shogi Club"), or Honkakuha Taikyoku Shogi: Shin Shogi Club ("The Authentic Shogi Playing School: New Shogi Club"), is a shogi game for the Super Famicom and the follow-up to Natsu System and Hect's previous shogi game, Honkakuha Taikyoku Shogi: Shogi Club, which was released seven months earlier on February 24th 1995.

The game includes additional features and is more of an improved remake of the original. Players still take on CPU opponents of varying difficulties with a suite of customization options.

481766.overview: Super Magro World is an unofficial El Chavo game starring Don Ramón as the player character that was made by CyberGamba, who goes on a quest through 6 areas to rescue La Chilindrina from Bowser.

482083.overview:
Sauna is back! Compared to my first hack this one has more levels, more chocolate, more secrets, more silliness, and it’s probably a bit more difficult. My goal was similar, to keep levels intuitive and fun, but I let myself get a bit crazier with level themes and ideas.

There are secret exits with hints that will guide you to the right direction, but they aren’t that hard to find even without the hints. Also, portrait rooms are back for people who enjoy looking around for secrets.

Get comfortable, grab your chilled beverage of choice, and get ready for löyly. I hope you’ll have a good time!

482085.overview:
Super Mario Worldle is an interactive, fan-made Wordle and GeoGuessr-inspired puzzle game built as a Super Mario World ROM hack by creator Medic for the 2025 Questionable Level Design Contest "Super Mario Worldle". 
The game challenges players to identify specific stages from the original 1990 SNES classic based on visual clues, map locations, or limited level characteristics.

482845.overview:
Mortal Kombat II vs Street Fighter 2 is an unofficial crossover ROM hack for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System, released publicly around November 2026.

Built upon Mortal Kombat II, the game combines fighters from Mortal Kombat II and Street Fighter II Turbo, bringing together characters, stages, and music from both classic fighting franchises.

The hack also allows Street Fighter characters to perform Fatalities, incorporating Mortal Kombat's signature finishing moves into the crossover.

Early versions feature some bugs and audio balancing issues, particularly with the Street Fighter music.

The project has reportedly been developed with assistance from Claude AI, although the identity of its original human creator remains unconfirmed. The game has been distributed through efr@16bit on itch.io.

This is an unofficial fan-made modification and is not affiliated with Midway, Capcom, or Nintendo.
